events.description: Minnesota United Soccer Celebration is an epic fan experience in downtown Minneapolis spanning Peavey Plaza and Nicollet Mall, right next to Brit's Pub. They'll have matches on the big screen, guest appearances, delicious food and beverage, a live DJ, and more.

events.description: Step into a treasure hunter's paradise as the Northeast Vintage Block Party returns. Dozens of vintage sellers will fill the large lot behind the historic buildings that house shops Moth Oddities, Olio Vintage, The Golden Pearl Vintage, and Twelve Vultures.

events.name: Midtown Arts & Music Festival
events.description: The Midtown Arts & Music Festival is a two day celebration of local creativity, culture and community. Experience live music, visual art, dance and interactive experiences alongside incredible global food & shopping, all under one roof!

events.name: Midsommar Celebration
events.description: Celebrate the longest day of the year, Swedish style! American Swedish Institute's Midsommar Celebration welcomes everyone to observe one of Sweden's favorite holidays with live music, dancing around the maypole, and many family-friendly activities.

events.name: Stone Arch Bridge Festival
events.description: The Stone Arch Bridge Festival features art and live music on the Minneapolis riverfront! The festival art market has more than 200 artists and culinary artists, plus two music stages featuring 28 performances and plenty of local food trucks and vendors.

events.name: 2026 Special Olympics USA Games
events.description: The 2026 Special Olympics USA Games are a monumental celebration of ability and inclusion set against the backdrop of the Twin Cities, scheduled to take place from June 20-26, 2026, at the University of Minnesota and the National Sports Center in Blaine.

events.name: 14th Annual Pride Beer Dabbler
events.description: Minnesota's favorite beer festival celebrating the Twin Cities queer community, great craft beer, and being Minnesotans! Features an evening of unlimited samples of delicious craft beer and cider from over 70 local and regional breweries, plus access to 12 of Minnesota's favorite food trucks.

events.name: Twin Cities Pride Festival
events.description: The Twin Cities Pride Festival is Minnesota's second largest festival and the largest FREE Pride festival in the country. The festival highlights the best in LGBTQIA2S+ entertainment on four stages and features over 650 vendors.

events.name: Time Travelers Vintage Expo
events.description: Time Travelers Vintage Expo is the most diverse traveling vintage market in the United States. Attendees can expect to find a vintage wonderland with the absolute best in vintage clothing, home goods, retro-inspired handmade, and more!

events.name: Tiny Desk Contest on the Road
events.description: National Public Radio's Tiny Desk Contest is back on the road in 2026! Join them as they travel to 10 cities for a one-of-a-kind concert, featuring the Contest winner plus two up-and-coming artists from each city.
